serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone is calling me again. I wonder who it might be.
ah… Of course. Mom. 
I’m so mad about her talking to my ex. I don’t even want to answer the call. 
How dare she bitch about her son with someone who backstabbed him not so long ago. 
Oh well… 
Let’s just get this over with. 
You: Hi mom. 
Mom: Hi honey, how are you?
You: Pretty bad to be honest. I got a certain message a few days ago, but there is no way you would know something about it, would you? 
Mom: Message? No, what do you mean? Did something happen? 
You: Did something happen? Yeah, something like that, but let’s first talk about you talking to my ex, alright? Did you ask her to check on me? 
Mom: N-no, I-I just sometimes text with her, that’s all.
You: From her message it seemed like you two were talking about me.
Mom: W-well, she is your friend, right? So I thought…
You: WHAT!? What did you think?! You thought that you talking behind my back with my ex would make things better? Are you actually retarded?!
Mom: Please, don’t be mad. I just want the best for you. 
You: Why are you so concerned about me?! I told you I’m fine! You just had to stick your nose in my business! 
Mom: It’s just that… I got a call from Dr Blaubleim week and a half ago and he told me that you stopped taking your anti-depressants again.
You: He called?! Why didn’t you tell me sooner!
Mom: I tried, but you hung up on me! Please, just take your pills, they will make you calmer and then we can talk things out.
You: Oh my God mom! These pills were making me stupid, I feel better than ever now! This fucker Blaubleim is a big pharma guy, he just wants to scam us on money! I told you this before! 
Mom: But you lost your job and you never texted me about your new company. And Tucky said on Tuesday’s news report that young males have a big unemployment crisis.
You: Shut up! Just shut up! I’m done with you, my ex, Tuckey and Dr Bluebleim. You all can rot in hell! Never call me back or I will block you!
